verdict.rationale: dlt is driven through a documented public Python API: `dlt.pipeline()`, `pipeline.run()`, and `pipeline.dataset()` for querying, plus a decorator-based Python API for scheduling and deploying on dltHub. A community user corroborates that everything can be done via code, and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) make the API easy for agents to consume. Missing for 10: no HTTP/REST API or OpenAPI spec for the managed dltHub platform (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), and no in-depth API reference excerpts in the evidence.
